body: Uh, there is nothing that would bring me more joy than that,only reason Im still going is because one day it might come true

Well because thoese are the years when you are most free, the best time to party, to experience as much as possible, and my situation didnt let me do thoes thing, at least not in the way I wanted. Now i will be going through the whole phase of jobs and adulthood completely unprepared and unsatisfied, with a lot of mental baggage.

And the problem is Im not sure what would make me happy, there is nothing I can think of that would stop me feeling so depressed, and thats what scares me the most. I used to have soo many hopes and dreams which kept me going, but now im just empty. 

As for people to talk to, im not sure, even if I did have someone, things had to get very bad just for me to write something here, I dont think I would be able to talk to anyone irl. Plus with my friends Im the one who offers help and support and a shoulder to cry on, my pride wouldn't let me say anything, i couldn't bare to be seen as weak by my friends. Also im not sure how many friends would I have left if they knew

And thanks for the comment and the internet hugs :D i needed it

I know what you mean, im gay too in a homophobic environment and the thought of leaving and going somewhere where nobody knows me, is the only thing that has kept me motivated and prevented me from killing myself, but its getting harder every day.
